title: Shared pill, findings-list and diff components
description: User story under REQ-181. Three view modules land under src/view/components/: pill, findings-list, diff. Readiness is their first consumer; existing Product Map and Requirements rendering keeps its markup where the swap is not mechanical, and no existing test expectation changes in that case. See the DEFINE step 2 spec dated 2026-10-01 (section 5) for the component contract.
iWant: one pill, one findings list and one diff component
soThat: gate state, persona, level verdict and AC class read the same on every tab

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given the pill component, when rendered with a gate state, a level verdict, a persona or an AC class, then it emits the same markup shape with a vocabulary class per value.
[happy] Given the findings-list component, when called with the same inputs from the Readiness and Product Map callers, then the two call sites produce byte-identical markup.
[must-not] Given the shared components, when introduced, then no existing Product Map or Requirements test changes its expected output except where this PR explicitly re-points that tab.
